podcast.title: High Bit Rate Streaming
podcast.body: Tidal is a streaming service that provides high bit rate streaming, addressing the growing demand among music fans for superior audio quality. This offering is part of the broader industry movement towards lossless and high-resolution audio formats. "Streaming services like title, desert, cubas, and Amazon music offer high bit rate streaming."
